title: HealthcareGuy.com
summary: The longest continuous record in the publishing program: a personal site where health IT arguments, field observations, and invention sketches have been published in public for two decades.
detail: HealthcareGuy.com is where the public record starts. It is not a corporate blog; it is a running notebook written while building systems, filing patents, and advising buyers. The posts are dated, specific, and usually angry at the gap between what a system promises and what it actually does.

We treat it as a portfolio work because it is an owned audience and a standing proof of reputation. A publication you rent can change its algorithm tomorrow. One you own can carry the same argument for twenty years.

Many of the ideas that became patent families, funds, and ventures first appeared there as a paragraph or a diagram. The site is the raw feed; the rest of the register is what survived the decide step.
